items.q: Which accounting standard governs revenue recognition in construction?
items.why: ASC 606 is the current standard for revenue recognition, replacing ASC 605.

items.q: If a project has incurred $2,000,000 in costs and total estimated costs are $5,000,000, what is the percentage of completion?
items.why: Percentage of completion = Costs incurred / Total estimated costs = $2M / $5M = 40%
